name: filescope
description: Inspect file properties without leaving the editor: permissions, ownership, size and timestamps in the status bar, full stat details in a panel.
author: banochkin.com DAO <mail@banochkin.com>

virtualWorkspaces.description: In virtual workspaces only size, type and timestamps reported by the file system provider are available. Permissions, ownership and inode details require a local or remote file system.

filescope.statusBar.enabled.description: Show file properties in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: File type as a single character, as in `ls -l` (- d l p s b c).
POSIX permission bits, for example rwxr-xr-x. Ignored on Windows.
Owning user, resolved to a name when possible. Ignored on Windows.
Owning group, resolved to a name when possible. Ignored on Windows.
Creation time, where the file system records one.

filescope.statusBar.items.markdownDescription: Properties to show in the status bar, in the order listed. POSIX-only entries are skipped automatically on Windows.

filescope.statusBar.alignment.description: Side of the status bar to place the item on.

filescope.statusBar.priority.description: Position within its side of the status bar. A higher value moves the item further left.

filescope.statusBar.separator.description: Separator placed between status bar properties.

filescope.statusBar.showLabels.description: Append a short label to each timestamp in the status bar, for example (M) for the modification time.

filescope.size.unit.description: Unit system used to render file sizes.

filescope.time.relative.description: Render timestamps as relative time, for example "2 hours ago", instead of an absolute date.

filescope.ownership.resolveNames.description: Resolve numeric uid and gid to user and group names. Requires running a short-lived stat process; disable to always show the raw numbers.

filescope.details.followActiveFile.description: Keep the details panel in sync with the active file. When disabled, the panel keeps showing the file it was opened for.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile
